title: A machine takes the next helper without optional settings or host add
description: The shipped helper runs under GY-3895's previous launcher with a clean environment and the signers file host add writes. Unsigned and wrongly signed updates are refused. A running test install's host-reading loop sends the next signed helper without sudo or host add and reports the machine ready through its API. SSH and Docker use the isolated host fixture.

steps.name: the helper verifies updates without signers environment and the running install updates its machine
